text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Christmas.
Apparently, it is a special day for the world to spend
with family, lovers, and friends.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, for some, it's just an ordinary weekday.
While flipping through the stack of documents on my desk and contemplating next year's schedule—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)
choice_data_list: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Ooh, caught that serious look of yours!
choice_data_list: Hey, taking photos without asking isn't very nice.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm sorry. I couldn't help myself.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it might be nice to wrap things up
with a casual, everyday moment like this~."
choice_data_list: The end?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When I checked today,
the camera's memory card was almost full.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm switching to a new card anyway,
I figured I might as well max out
my current one first!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"It's been exactly three years since I started using it.
And this card is meant to be my lifelong treasure, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's take the last 4 together with Trainer!
Say cheese!
choice_data_list: No, no! It'd be a waste to save the last bite for me!
No, no! It'd be a waste to save the last bite for me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Huh, really?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I really wanted to use it all up
by the end of today, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is she just stubborn, or is she careless?
Rhein Kraft's sudden sigh
makes me chuckle despite myself."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I glanced at the work piled on my desk.
Even if I don't finish today,
I should be able to make it up over the next two days... hopefully.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's head out then!
Got it, shall we head out then?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Let's go take a photo worthy of being our final memory.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaaaah……! So dazzling……!
The juices from the roast chicken are……! Ugh……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Are you really sure...!?
For me to indulge in such an exclusive
Christmas-only buffet...!
choice_data_list: Ah, nice! Let's take a picture too!
Yeah, sure! Let's take a photo too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ngggh... Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, Trainer-san!
Is Tracen Academy over in that direction?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehe. Even if you look back at it later,
it might be too small to tell, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Santa! There's a Santa! Everyone's lining up to take pictures!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's go get in line too!!
Okay, let's go get in line too!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
Next, let's take a photo under the tree!
And then, and then—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――Ah.
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...It looks like this next one is the last page.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Three years' worth of memories...
They're all getting buried, aren't they?
choice_data_list: ...Did you have fun?
...Did you have fun?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes, thanks to you.
It was a fulfilling three years.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And thank you so much...
for staying with me all the way to the end of the year like this.
choice_data_list: Same here.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san.
As for that last ticket—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Why don't we take a photo together?
As the culmination of these three years.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I believe I was able to keep running
because you were right there beside me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...May I?
choice_data_list: Got it, shall we do that then?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after taking one last photo together,
Rhein Kraft gently stroked the camera.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text:
It's Rhein Kraft!!
Rhein Kraft!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Backpack
text_block_list.text:
Um! I watched the Oka Sho and the NHK Mile Cup!
I just love mile races too!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um! I'm aiming for it!
I want to become just like you.
So, uh—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Could I take a picture with you!?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Huh?
Um—...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――Are you sure you're okay with me?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Backpack
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
choice_data_list: ...Craft, lend me the camera.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san!
U-Um. I—
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take the last photo with them.
Yeah, let's take the last photo with them.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ...please!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Come here, both of you!
Hug tighter!! Come on, come on!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Backpack
text_block_list.text:
Huh, waahh...~~!
Ehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft huddles close like dango with the two girls,
flashing a bright smile.
choice_data_list: Okay, I'm gonna take the picture!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Giving a cue, I take a photo of the three girls using the smartphone camera they handed me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And next, with Rhine Kraft's camera.
choice_data_list: (...What a great smile.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It would surely have made the best photo of all,
worthy of being the final shot on the memory card.
